license_note: Palette/mood inspired by beautiful-feishu-whiteboard templates; translated to Feishu Card JSON 2.0 constraints.

component_constraints.root_shell: body.padding must be 0; body.elements[0] must be an interactive_container carrying the whole-card background and padding. This body-replacement layer must not add border or corner radius, otherwise it overlaps the Feishu message bubble.
component_constraints.contrast: Every background token should have a matching on_* foreground token. Dark or mid-dark accent/button surfaces must use white or cream foreground text instead of muted/ink text.
component_constraints.theme_button: Theme Button must be a clickable interactive_container using the theme button/background token and fixed padding "8px 12px 8px 12px". Do not rely on parent spacing to create button tap area.

styles.name: Lime Slab
styles.vibe: electric, bold, modern SaaS, neobrutalist landing-page
rules: Use electric lime as the canvas or one broad ambient field, not as every highlight block.
Use ink-black for primary highlight columns; pair with white text for strong slab contrast.
Flat blocks, charcoal borders, no shadows.
Mock buttons should be ink-black with white text.

styles.name: Editorial Forest
styles.vibe: literary, bookish, forest green and dusty rose, paper-like
rules: Keep vocabulary small: cream, forest, rose.
Use forest for primary heading/border, rose for one accent surface.
Squared editorial surfaces, low radius.

styles.name: Monochrome
rules: No accent color; hierarchy comes from scale, border, spacing.
Use cream siblings only for subtle inset surfaces.
Use squared low-radius panels.

styles.name: Macchiato
styles.vibe: warm monochrome, almond and espresso, cozy quiet
rules: No bright accent; almond surface plus espresso ink.
Warm taupe for secondary text.
Quiet radius 0-14px.

styles.name: Neo-Grid Bold
styles.vibe: editorial grid, bold, structured, brutalist annual report
rules: Strict block grid; no rounded corners.
Exactly one neon lemon accent.
Use thick ink borders for frame and panel separation.

styles.name: Court Press
styles.vibe: sporty, athletic, energetic, pink and green clash
rules: Green leads, pink punches.
White panels need thin green borders.
Squared cards; energy comes from scale and color blocks.

styles.name: Soft Editorial
styles.vibe: warm magazine, soft pastels, gentle editorial page
rules: Cream page with pastel cards.
Pastels are paints, not semantic status colors.
Rounded cards 16-28px, generous space.

styles.name: Handdrawn Vibes
styles.vibe: cream paper, hand-drawn black icons, pastel blue and warm yellow highlight blocks
rules: Use cream canvas and black ink as the base; color belongs in a few large rounded highlight blocks.
Pair pastel blue and warm yellow blocks side by side, with hand-drawn doodle icons centered above short labels.
Use thin separators and one bold ink underline for tab-like hierarchy; avoid gradients and photo backgrounds.

styles.name: Handdrawn Dark
styles.vibe: black sketchbook canvas, near-white typography, neutral white borders, neon green, hot orange and soft purple highlights
rules: Use near-black as the canvas, not pure black. Body and panel must step up in luminance so containers remain visible against the card background.
Do not simulate gradients with unsupported CSS. Use discrete tonal steps: near-black canvas, deep ink panel, and saturated highlight columns.
Use neutral white borders for panels and media-list surfaces; reserve neon green, hot orange and soft purple for highlights and chart accents.

Black safe16 doodle icons must sit on wb_handdrawn_dark_icon_surface or another dedicated neutral light icon shell; do not use panel, column, accent, translucent black, or border-only dark shells for icon backgrounds.

styles.name: Wellness Planner
styles.vibe: warm cream lifestyle planner, rounded cards, olive buttons, terracotta, sage, blush and soft yellow blocks
rules: Use warm cream as the app-like canvas and rounded paper panels; avoid pure white and default blue.
Use terracotta, sage, blush and soft yellow as structured plan blocks, not random decorative colors.
Prefer input-like pills, day chips, segmented plan rows, and bottom pill buttons for lifestyle planner tasks.

styles.name: Claude Chrome
styles.vibe: airy product page, off-white canvas, deep cream panels, and mint accents
styles.description: Inspired by claude.com/claude-for-chrome and translated to supported Card JSON 2.0 surfaces without CSS gradients.
rules: Keep the composition airy, quiet and productized.
Use deep cream panels and mint accents as discrete surfaces; do not simulate gradients.
Use semantic doodle icons selected for the current content, not template image keys.
